split_60_40_stationary_heavy.finding: Higher BESS provides slightly better peak shaving but swap queues lengthen during morning surge.

split_40_60_swap_heavy.finding: Higher swap inventory guarantees near 100% 2W/3W pack availability but reduces BESS peak arbitrage capacity.

equal_split_baseline.allocation: 120 MWh / 240 MW per cluster across all 5 metros

metro_demand_weighted.allocation: Delhi 160 MWh / 320 MW, Mumbai 160 MWh / 320 MW, Bengaluru 100 MWh / 200 MW, Hyd 90 MWh / 180 MW, Chennai 90 MWh / 180 MW
metro_demand_weighted.finding: Matching capacity to tier-1 metro demand reduces peak DISCOM overage in Delhi/Mumbai by ~3.5%.

low_wear_1500_inr_mwh.impact: Controller utilizes BESS more aggressively for intraday price arbitrage.

baseline_2500_inr_mwh.impact: Balanced cycling strictly when IEX/DISCOM spread exceeds INR 2,800/MWh.

high_wear_4000_inr_mwh.impact: BESS held primarily as emergency reserve; arbitrage dispatched only during severe price spikes.
